about: Names (and the short texts inside the files) of the fictional sample folder of the website's captures and demonstration, per app language. Keys are English ids of the items (their Brazilian Portuguese originals are the pt-BR entry); extensions and '2025' are kept. Used by make_fixtures.py --lang and capture_finder_menu.py --lang; the website demonstration can read the same names.

ownerApproved.source: the owner approved every suggestion of a reviewer (GPT-6.2 Sol)

review.note: Draft translations: every entry other than pt-BR and the names listed in ownerApproved still needs the owner's review (the texts inside the files included). The archive (key 'photosArchive') must sort among the first items of the folder by name: Finder's shortcut menu opens at the archive's icon, and an archive sorted last pushes the Zforge submenu to the left of the menu (hence 'Album-2025' in Polish, Russian and Ukrainian). Where a native word equals the Portuguese one, the owner prefers a clearly native name, except Spanish 'Fotos', kept by the owner's choice (2026-11-18).
